name: WildClawBench
intro: WildClawBench 是 Hy3-preview 报告中与 ClawEval 一起出现的 Agent 能力评测，用于考察更贴近真实 OpenClaw 使用场景的任务表现。
intro_en: WildClawBench is an agent capability benchmark referenced by the Hy3-preview report alongside ClawEval, targeting more realistic OpenClaw-style tasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with WildClawBench arXiv:2605.10912v1 (2026-05-11), Sections 3.1-3.4, Figure 4, Tables 1-2; official repository https://github.com/internlm/WildClawBench, May-2026 release. The benchmark compares four practical harness configurations with their own system prompts, tool schemas, and context; it does not impose one identical system prompt.. WildClawBench packages each task as a Markdown/YAML specification, workspace assets, rubric, executable grader, and post-exit hidden grading materials. Eight researchers and experts iterate through frontier-model pilots, a >=0.2 pairwise-gap gate, joint trace/grader review, and stability/reproducibility rechecks to retain 60 executable tasks. At runtime the same tasks fan out to OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes in isolated Docker environments; timeout preserves partial artifacts, hidden ground truth is mounted only after exit, and up to three evidence channels feed rubric and task-count-weighted scoring.
